ns2:course.label: Theatre Foundations: Production
ns2:course.description: Provides an overview of historical and contemporary production practices focused on designing, building and managing a theatrical performance. Students will consider what performance production means within its social and historical context and develop a theatrical vocabulary essential to participating in the production process and in conducting research into production practices. Credit is not given for both THEA 103 and THEA 123. Prerequisite: BFA Theatre Majors Only.
